tips.text: Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward; solo cracks pay far fewer Ducats.
Keep the Ducats and credits banked before Baro lands so a surprise visit never catches you short.
Check his stock the moment Baro lands; he leaves after 48 hours and the next visit may not carry it.
Players treat it as free Mastery once the Ducats are banked; the only friction is waiting for Baro.
